metadata.title: On the dichotomy of $p$-walk dimensions on metric measure spaces II
metadata.abstract: On a volume doubling metric measure space endowed with a family of $p$-energies such that the Poincaré inequality and the capacity upper bound with $p$-walk dimension $\beta_p$ hold, for $p$ in an open interval $I\subseteq(1,+\infty)$, we prove the following dichotomy: either $\beta_p=p$ for all $p\in I$, or the function $p\mapsto \frac{\beta_p}{p}$ takes values in $(1,+\infty)$ and is strictly decreasing on $I$. Moreover, if the metric measure space is $d_h$-Ahlfors regular, we prove the following dichotomy: either $\beta_p=d_h+p-1$ for all $p\in I$, or the function $p\mapsto \frac{\beta_p-d_h}{p-1}$ takes values in $(-\infty,1)$ and is strictly increasing on $I$.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在体积倍增空间的一族p-能量满足相应Poincaré及容量上界时，对开区间I⊂(1,∞)有：或βp=p处处成立，或βp/p>1且严格递减。若另有dh-Ahlfors正则，则或βp=dh+p−1处处成立，或(βp−dh)/(p−1)<1且严格递增。
analysis.breakthrough: 把walk维数随p变化的单调性强化为含刚性等号分支的二分。
analysis.limitations: 两项二分依赖不同层次假设；第二项需要Ahlfors正则，不能仅凭倍增推出；结论只在给定开区间内。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
